fusions.name: Clamp Down
fusions.desc: Seizes a target up to 4 tiles away, dealing 8 damage with a 40% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Rallying Slam
fusions.desc: Brings your plates down hard, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Allies within 5 tiles strike 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pick Out Burrs
fusions.desc: Dispels 2 hostile effects on you and your allies.

fusions.name: Steady Hold
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and your armour by 6%.
